data.name: Marvan
data.gender_notes: Marvan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Marvan is a name that refers to the lord or master of the forest, emphasizing the importance of nature and the connection with the environment. The name Marvan carries the meaning “Lord of the forest” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marvan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the forest and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Marvan is a name that represents the inner strength and resilience of an individual. It is a reminder that no matter how dark or difficult the situation may be, there is always a precious jewel within, waiting to be discovered.
data.etymology: Marvan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the forest.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marvan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مروان
in_arabic.long_meaning: مروان هو اسم عربي مشتق من الكلمة العربية مر، التي تعني القوة والشجاعة، وقد كان هذا الاسم شائعا في العصور الإسلامية الأولى، و特别 بين الصحابة، وقد حمل هذا الاسم العديد من الشخصيات التاريخية البارزة، مثل مروان بن الحكم، الذي كان خليفة أمويا، وتحمل这个 الاسم دلالة روحية عميقة في الإسلام، حيث يرمز إلى القوة والصلابة في الإيمان

in_urdu.name: مروان
in_urdu.long_meaning: مروان نام کا مطلب ہے مزیدور اور بہادر آدمی، یہ نام عربوں کے دور میں بہت مشہور تھا، اور خاص طور پر صحابہ کرام میں، مروان بن الحكم جیسے تاریخی شخصیتوں نے بھی یہ نام رکھا تھا، جو اموی خلیفہ تھے، اور اسلامی روایت میں اس نام کی روحانی اہمیت بھی ہے، جو ایمان کی قوت اور استحکام کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: मारवान
in_hindi.long_meaning: मारवान नाम का अर्थ है मज़बूत और साहसी व्यक्ति, यह नाम अरबी मूल का है, और इस्लामी इतिहास में इसका महत्व है, ख़ासकर सहाबा के बीच, मारवान बिन अल-हकम जैसे ऐतिहासिक व्यक्तियों ने भी इस नाम को धारण किया था, जो उमय्यद ख़लीफ़ा थे, और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका आध्यात्मिक महत्व भी है, जो ईमान की ताक़त और स्थिरता का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: مرван
in_pashto.long_meaning: مرван نوم د قوي او د شجاع سړي په معنا دی، دا نوم عربي ریښې څخه دی، او په اسلامي تاریخ کې دده اهمیت دی، ځانگړي له صحابه کرامو څخه، مرван بن الحکم په څیر تاریخي شخصیتونو هم دا نوم درلود، چې اموی خلیفه وو، او په اسلامي دود کې دده روحاني اهمیت دی، چې ایمان د قوت او استحکام نمáyndه دی

in_english.name: Marvan
in_english.long_meaning: Marvan means strong and courageous person, derived from Arabic root, significant in Islamic history, especially among companions, historical figures like Marwan bin Al-Hakam held this name, who was an Umayyad caliph, and has spiritual importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing strength and stability of faith

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name Marvan holds deep cultural significance, as the name is a reminder of the interconnected relationship between humans and nature. In certain regions, marriage and the starting of a new family is seen as a connection to the land, and the name Marvan represents the guardian and protector of this relationship. In many Islamic cultures, there is a profound respect and appreciation for natural resources, and the name Marvan can be considered a reflection of this value.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Marvan can be interpreted as a reminder of the role of stewardship and responsibility towards the natural world. The name carries an intrinsic sense of respect and reverence for the gift of nature, urging individuals to care for and protect it. As stated in the Quran, "It is He Who raised among theatalogers of His servants [Prophet Muhammad SAW] an army which said: 'Our Lord! I will certainly wage war for Thee with my life and my wealth'" (23:9). The spiritual significance of the name Marvan is one that encourages individuals to honor and preserve the natural world, as a means of showing gratitude to God for the blessings bestowed upon us.
